description: An additive sawtooth built from up to 512 partials, which makes it free of aliasing at any pitch

params.text: Sets the pitch, -8 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 1Hz to 4186Hz
Shifts the pitch by up to a tenth of an octave either way
Scatters the phases again at the setting chosen, which changes the sound without changing the harmonics
Picks how the phases are set at a reset: 0 puts them all at the start, and WB, Chy and Nrm draw them from a Weibull, a Cauchy or a normal distribution
Sets how many partials are added, as a power of two from 1 to 512; fewer partials soften the wave and cost less to compute
Sets the seed the scattering is drawn from, 0 to 1, so the same scattering can be had again
Sets how far the phases of the partials are scattered when they are reset, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
A trigger here scatters the phases again at the setting chosen

notes: with the phase mode at 0 the wave is an ordinary saw; the other three settings give the same harmonics with the partials out of step, which takes the edge off the transient
menu: use thread — works the partials out on a background thread, which keeps them off the audio thread at the cost of some delay
Thread buffer size — sets how many samples that background thread works on at a time; a larger buffer glitches less and delays more

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
